action_legality_checks.policy_evidence: For pending orders, item modification requires specifying a new item of the same product but different option for each item being changed. The number of items to be exchanged must match, and items cannot simply be removed.
action_legality_checks.conversation_evidence: User requested to remove three items from a pending order and keep the rest. Assistant attempted to call modify_pending_order_items with only item_ids to remove and an empty new_item_ids list.
action_legality_checks.reasoning: The attempted action tried to remove items from a pending order without specifying replacement items, which is not supported by policy or tools. The modify_pending_order_items tool requires a one-to-one mapping of old to new items (same product, different option), not removal. The assistant should have explained this limitation and offered permitted alternatives before attempting a write.
action_legality_checks.correct_action: Explain to the user that individual item removal is not supported for pending orders; offer to modify items to different variants or to cancel the entire order as alternatives, and obtain confirmation before any write.
